outcome: Functional results (Cleveland Clinic Constipation scale score, Incontinence scale score, P-Qol, and PGII)
cohort: Patients aged 18 to 70 years who underwent laparoscopic ventral mesh rectopexy for rectocele and/or rectal prolapse.
finding: 3D laparoscopic ventral mesh rectopexy for rectocele and rectal prolapse is comparable in long-term results to traditional laparoscopy but offers shorter operation time, reduced pain, less blood loss, smaller fluid collection, and enhanced surgeon comfort.
